items.title: Quoting Calif Research
items.title_zh: Calif Research发布WeWorm：通过微信通话传播的零点击蠕虫
items.title_en: Calif Research Unveils WeWorm, Zero-Click WeChat Call Worm
items.summary: Calif Research claims WeWorm is the first zero-click worm spreading through WeChat calls on iOS and Android, built with AI-assisted RCE exploit development in about a week.

items.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
items.title_zh: Shopify 弃用 React Native，回归 Swift 与 Kotlin 原生开发
items.title_en: Shopify Moves from React Native Back to Native Swift and Kotlin
items.summary: Shopify's engineering blog explains why the company is migrating from React Native back to native Swift and Kotlin, sparking a large HN debate on cross-platform framework tradeoffs and AI-assisted rewrites.

items.title: More questions about whether researchers can trust OpenAI with unpublished math
items.title_zh: 研究者质疑能否将未发表的数学成果托付给OpenAI
items.title_en: Researchers question whether OpenAI can be trusted with unpublished math
items.summary: A Hacker News discussion raises concerns about whether researchers can trust OpenAI with unpublished mathematical work after reports of models producing results similar to confidential collaborations.

items.title: NASA technique for manipulating satellite photos now reveals ancient images
items.title_zh: NASA的卫星图像处理技术如今用于揭示古代岩画
items.title_en: NASA's Satellite Image Trick Now Reveals Ancient Rock Art
items.summary: NASA's decorrelation stretch technique, originally developed for satellite photos, is being used to reveal ancient rock art and archaeological images.

items.title: Rust is tier-1 language at Microsoft
items.title_zh: 微软正式将 Rust 列为一级（Tier-1）语言
items.title_en: Microsoft Declares Rust a Tier-1 Language
items.summary: Microsoft formalizes Rust as a tier-1 language, underscoring industry momentum for memory-safe systems programming and prompting discussion of large-scale C/C++ migration efforts.

items.title: 🤖 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash：更强、更快、更普惠
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash：552B 多模态稀疏激活模型
items.title_en: DeepSeek Releases V4.1 Flash: 552B Multimodal Model With Sparse Activation
items.summary: DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash, a 552B-parameter multimodal Causal-Encoder-Decoder model with sparse activation, now available via API.

items.summary: DeepSeek launched the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness app with a plugin-based architecture and released the DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 model weights on Hugging Face.

items.title_en: Moonshot AI Confidentially Files for Hong Kong IPO at $50B Pre-Money Valuation
items.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has confidentially filed its A1 form with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to begin an IPO process, raising a new round at a ~$50B pre-money valuation after valuation grew roughly 8x in six months.
